subject.title: feat(ui): path-based session and dashboard URLs

question: Should existing released Control UI and ClickClack query-form session links continue to resolve after the path URL rollout?
rationale: The branch explicitly chooses a breaking URL-contract change, and deciding whether to preserve old shared/bookmarked links is a user-facing compatibility policy choice rather than a local implementation detail.

options.title: Preserve released links
options.body: Accept path URLs as canonical but parse legacy query-form links and replace them with the equivalent canonical path after resolution.

options.title: Approve a breaking cutover
options.body: Land the removal only with explicit maintainer acceptance that existing bookmarks and previously published ClickClack links will fail after upgrade.

options.title: Limit the rollout
options.body: Ship path URLs only for newly generated links while retaining the current query reader until a separately approved deprecation plan exists.

recommendation.title: Preserve released links
recommendation.body: Accept path URLs as canonical but parse legacy query-form links and replace them with the equivalent canonical path after resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete is assigned to this PR and authored the proposed routing and link-contract design.
